subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should OpenClaw standardize cross-session recall and restart warming as core defaults, and which privacy-scoped metrics contract—if any—should be exposed to agents and integrations?
rationale: Current code supplies substantial mechanisms but cannot determine consent, channel scope, retention, default-on behavior, or the long-lived public API expected for evaluation metrics.

options.title: Split into bounded core decisions
options.body: Keep this umbrella for context, but route transcript-continuity policy to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51386 and create separate scoped proposals for metrics and restart-latency behavior.

options.title: Retain one umbrella roadmap
options.body: Keep all remaining requests here and require a single design covering privacy, telemetry, session semantics, and startup lifecycle before implementation.

options.title: Limit core to existing mechanisms
options.body: Document the current opt-in memory and usage surfaces while directing specialized evaluation or temporal-memory systems to plugins or external integrations.

recommendation.title: Split into bounded core decisions
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella for context, but route transcript-continuity policy to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51386 and create separate scoped proposals for metrics and restart-latency behavior.
